explanation: The theorem is the computation rule (`rfl`) for `CountAssembly.mulEquiv`, an `≃ₗ[k]` on the product type `∀ i, Fb i` defined locally in the library as multiplication by a pointwise-nonzero `u` (with inverse `u⁻¹ * x`). Its statement mentions this library-local definition, which no Mathlib declaration can reproduce. Searching Mathlib for `mulEquiv_apply`, `mulEquiv`, `mulLeft_apply`, `unitsSMul`, etc. turns up only unrelated notions (`TransferInstance.mulEquiv`, `Basis.unitsSMul`, `LinearMap.mulLeft`), none of which is a `≃ₗ[k]`-level structure lemma for pointwise multiplication on a pi-type of fields.
